rationale: Land area is fixed and the tax falls on every hectare whatever its use, so there is no untaxed use to move into and the stock traded should change little; the tax is mainly capitalised into land prices.
evidence: Every owner pays a yearly tax of 40 Garrow dollars per hectare of land they own, whatever the land is used for, including land left idle.
The total area of land in Garrow is fixed by its borders, and every hectare is owned by someone.
